This analysis is based on three main data sources: [...] Most Asian origin groups have also seen declines in their shares of immigrants. Hmong had the sharpest drop, from 55% in 2000 to 31% in 2023. By contrast, the share of Thai who were immigrants had the smallest decrease, going from 78% to 74%. [...] In 2023, households headed by an Asian person had a median income of $105,600. This is higher than the median income for U.S. households overall ($75,500), but there were large differences across Asian origin groups. Indian- ($151,200) and Taiwanese-headed ($133,300) households had higher median annual incomes than Asian-headed households overall.
